scope: Whole archived guide and pinned HTML; source interpretation, not human/server verification

1.original_instruction: Speak to Survey Leader (juno 176, 186), and bring him 20 Ice Cubic and 5 Ice Cream . The Survey Leader asks you to collect a TPS Report from a team in Nogg Road.
1.short_ru: Принесите Survey Leader: 20 Ice Cubic и 5 Ice Cream, juno 176, 186.
1.short_en: Bring Survey Leader: 20 Ice Cubic and 5 Ice Cream, juno 176, 186.
1.full_ru: Поговорите с Survey Leader (juno 176, 186) и принесите 20 Ice Cubic и 5 Ice Cream. Survey Leader попросит забрать TPS Report у команды в Nogg Road.
1.full_en: Speak to Survey Leader (juno 176, 186), and bring him 20 Ice Cubic and 5 Ice Cream . The Survey Leader asks you to collect a TPS Report from a team in Nogg Road.

2.original_instruction: On level 2 of Magma Dungeon , speak to Surveyor Peter (mag_dun02 247, 62), he didn't feel like doing his TPS Report.
2.full_ru: На уровне 2 Magma Dungeon поговорите с Surveyor Peter (mag_dun02 247, 62): он не захотел делать TPS Report.
2.full_en: On level 2 of Magma Dungeon , speak to Surveyor Peter (mag_dun02 247, 62), he didn't feel like doing his TPS Report.

3.original_instruction: Speak to Surveyor Bob to collect a completed TPS Report.
3.short_ru: Заберите TPS Report у Surveyor Bob.
3.short_en: Collect TPS Report from Surveyor Bob.
3.full_ru: Поговорите с Surveyor Bob и заберите готовый TPS Report.
3.full_en: Speak to Surveyor Bob to collect a completed TPS Report.

4.original_instruction: Return to Survey Leader with the completed TPS Report. Survey Leader asks you to investigate the Lava Tubes in Nogg Road.
4.short_ru: Отнесите TPS Report Survey Leader и получите задание исследовать Lava Tubes.
4.short_en: Take TPS Report to Survey Leader and receive the Lava Tubes investigation.
4.full_ru: Вернитесь к Survey Leader с готовым TPS Report. Survey Leader попросит исследовать Lava Tubes в Nogg Road.
4.full_en: Return to Survey Leader with the completed TPS Report. Survey Leader asks you to investigate the Lava Tubes in Nogg Road.

5.original_instruction: Walk directly over the cell at (mag_dun02 244, 75) to be warped to one of several locations on Thor Volcano 2 .
5.short_ru: Наступите на mag_dun02 244, 75 для переноса на Thor Volcano 2.
5.short_en: Step on mag_dun02 244, 75 to warp to Thor Volcano 2.
5.full_ru: Пройдите точно по клетке (mag_dun02 244, 75), чтобы перенестись в одну из нескольких точек Thor Volcano 2.
5.full_en: Walk directly over the cell at (mag_dun02 244, 75) to be warped to one of several locations on Thor Volcano 2 .

actions.condition: Walk directly over the cell; destination is one of several Thor Volcano 2 locations.

6.original_instruction: Return to the Survey Leader and receive some EXP. | 100,000 Base EXP / 75,000 Job EXP | Note: After completing the quest you can return to (mag_dun02 244, 75) and be warped to Thor Volcano 2 as many times as you want. The quest itself is not repeatable.
6.short_ru: Вернитесь к Survey Leader: 100,000 Base EXP / 75,000 Job EXP; повторяется только перенос.
6.short_en: Return to Survey Leader: 100,000 Base EXP / 75,000 Job EXP; only the warp is repeatable.
6.full_ru: Вернитесь к Survey Leader за опытом: 100,000 Base EXP / 75,000 Job EXP. Примечание: после завершения можно снова приходить к (mag_dun02 244, 75) и переноситься на Thor Volcano 2 сколько угодно раз. Сам квест повторить нельзя.
6.full_en: Return to the Survey Leader and receive some EXP. | 100,000 Base EXP / 75,000 Job EXP | Note: After completing the quest you can return to (mag_dun02 244, 75) and be warped to Thor Volcano 2 as many times as you want. The quest itself is not repeatable.

rewards.condition: Repeatable warp from mag_dun02 244,75; quest and experience rewards are not repeatable.

reviews.detail: Pinned page categories are IRO Only Events & Features and Premium Server Events & Features. This optional shortcut is not required for ordinary Thor floor-two access and is not asserted available on other servers.
The source spells Survey Leader location juno. Preserve it; do not silently substitute yuno or assert a validated map code.
Warp reuse is unlimited after completion, but the quest and EXP rewards cannot be repeated.
